actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Serum Injection
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.frequency: At will while legal doses remain
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Serum Injection. Choose one equipped mutation and one prepared serum dose. Consume the dose, activate that mutation for 3 rounds and apply the serum profile for 3 rounds. Observe active-mutation limits, Strain legality and nonstacking same-profile bonuses.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Brutal Strike
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: One creature within your weapon reach
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.duration: Instantaneous; Stagger until end of target's next turn
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Brutal Strike. Make one melee weapon attack using its normal ability. On hit add S d6 damage of the weapon's type. The target makes a Constitution save; on failure it is Staggered, taking -1 on attack rolls and -5 feet Speed until the end of its next turn. This is not a full-turn denial.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Mutation Adaptation
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Mutation Adaptation. Ignore the Strain-2 Speed penalty. The first time in each encounter that activating a mutation or serum would add Strain, reduce that Strain gain by 1, minimum 0. This reduction cannot reduce Serum Cocktail or Mutation Overload below 1 Strain and cannot reduce existing Strain.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Serum Tolerance
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Serum Tolerance. Negative side effects printed on serum profiles do not affect you. Strain generation and Strain penalties still apply normally. This does not suppress drawbacks printed on mutation cards, Hero transformations or Mutation Overload.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Mutation Surge
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Mutation Surge. Enhance one active mutation. If it grants AC, DR, attack, save or flat damage, increase one such bonus by 1; if it grants movement or reach, increase it by 5 feet; if it deals mutation damage, add 1d4 to one damage event. A mutation with none of those numeric effects instead grants S temporary HP. The enhancement never changes immunity, target count or duration.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Intimidating Presence
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies of your choice within 15 feet that can see or hear you
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Intimidating Presence. Each target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it is Frightened of you until the end of its next turn, then repeats the save. A second failure extends the fear one final round. A creature that succeeds becomes immune to this use. This never forces surrender; NPC surrender remains a Director decision.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Mutation Overload
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.duration: 2 rounds; backlash until end of following turn
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Mutation Overload. For 2 rounds, enhance each currently active mutation once: an AC, DR, attack, save or flat-damage bonus increases by 1; a movement or reach bonus increases by 5 feet; or one mutation damage/healing roll gains +1d4. Immunities, target counts, resource generation and action grants cannot be increased. When Overload ends, you suffer -1 on attack rolls and saving throws and -5 feet Speed until the end of your next regular turn. This activation is illegal if +2 Strain would exceed the Strain cap.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Mutation Efficiency
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Mutation Efficiency. You may maintain up to two equipped mutations active simultaneously instead of one. Activating a third mutation while two are already active requires choosing one active mutation to become dormant unless another explicit feature temporarily raises this limit. Mutation slots, serum costs, Strain and mutation durations remain unchanged.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Combat Instinct
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Combat Instinct. Gain +1 on initiative rolls. You cannot be Surprised while conscious unless the opposing creature's Stealth check exceeds your passive Perception by 5 or more. This does not grant extra Actions or movement before combat.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Brutality Sense
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: Hostile creatures you can perceive within 60 feet
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Brutality Sense. You know when a visible hostile creature is at or below one-quarter of its maximum HP; it is Vulnerable for your Warrior features that specifically reference a marked vulnerable target. This does not reveal its exact HP or hidden resistances.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Crushing Advance
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: Self; 20-foot straight movement path and creatures crossed or approached within 5 feet
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Crushing Advance. Move up to 20 feet in a straight line without provoking opportunity attacks. Each enemy no more than one size larger whose space or reach-line you pass through or adjacent to makes a Strength save. On failure it takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage, is pushed to the nearest legal space outside your path and falls Prone. On success it takes half damage and is neither pushed nor Prone. A creature is affected once per use.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Survival Instinct
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Survival Instinct. Gain +2 on Perception checks, +2 on Dexterity saving throws and one additional Reaction usable only for Dodge-like defensive reactions, opportunity-free movement granted by a feature, or Deflect-style mitigation. It cannot make an attack or trigger another additional Reaction.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Serum Cocktail
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.cost: Consume 2 different prepared serum doses; +2 Strain
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Serum Cocktail. Choose two different prepared serum profiles, consume both doses and apply both profiles to yourself for 3 rounds while activating one eligible equipped mutation. Same-stat bonuses use only the stronger value. Both profile side effects apply unless Serum Tolerance suppresses them. This activates only one mutation and therefore differs from Serum Overclock. It is illegal if the resulting Strain would exceed 3.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Intimidating Transformation
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies of your choice within 20 feet that can see you
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Intimidating Transformation. Each target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it is Frightened of you until the end of its next turn and then repeats the save. On a failure by 10 or more, it would instead be Stunned until the end of its next turn, subject to the Warrior hard-control guard. A target succeeding on the initial save is immune to this use. The transformation does not force surrender or belief changes.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Guardian Tissue
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Guardian Tissue. When an adjacent ally would take damage, reduce that ally's incoming damage by one-third rounded down. You take the prevented amount as damage of the same type. This transferred damage cannot be redirected again and cannot trigger another Guardian Tissue. Transferred damage cannot be reduced again, redirected again or generate BT.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Bulwark Mutation Tree
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Bulwark Mutation Tree. Unlock the Wardborn-specific mutations Spinal Plating, Adrenal Overwatch and Living Cover as eligible mutation choices. They occupy normal mutation slots, require serum activation unless their card says otherwise, and obey all active-mutation, tier and Strain rules. Selecting this card does not automatically equip or activate any of them.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Mutation Slot I
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Gain one mutation slot. During a completed short or long rest, equip one eligible mutation in it. The equipped mutation remains dormant until activated unless its own text says otherwise.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Brutality Threshold Tracker
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Track Brutality Progress and BT using the common Warrior engine. Default BT cap is 3. Encounter end resets both to 0.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Mutagen Injection
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Choose Power or Guard. Power grants +2 Strength, maximum 22 from this feature. Guard grants +2 AC. This emergency mutagen does not consume a prepared serum dose and does not activate a mutation.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Mutation Slot II
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Gain a second mutation slot. This does not by itself raise the active-mutation concurrency limit.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Bone Hardened
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: While you are not Staggered, reduce physical weapon damage you take by 1 after resistance and before temporary HP.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Serum Overclock
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Inject two different prepared serum profiles simultaneously and activate up to two eligible equipped mutations, respecting your active-mutation limit. Resolve both profile effects; same-stat bonuses use the stronger. Overclock is illegal if the resulting Strain would exceed 3.
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.prerequisite: Warrior 9, Strain 1 or lower, two prepared serum doses

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Flesh Warden
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Increase maximum HP by 2 per Warrior level while equipped. Equipping raises maximum only, never current HP. Unequipping clamps current HP to the reduced maximum if necessary; it does not subtract another amount from current HP. Repeated swaps cannot heal.

currentApplicableEngineMechanicalDescrip: PROVISIONAL PLAYTEST CONTRACT. At Warrior level 1 choose Strength or Dexterity as your Warrior ability; this choice is permanent in this draft. S = 1/2/3/4 at Warrior levels 1/5/11/17. M = max(1, chosen Warrior ability modifier). Warrior technique attack = d20 + normal character proficiency bonus + chosen modifier. Warrior technique save DC = 8 + normal character proficiency bonus + chosen modifier. Source basis: approved Player Rulebook extract and preserved class registry.

MUTATION SLOTS. At Warrior 1 you have one mutation slot; slot II unlocks at Warrior 5, slot III at Warrior 13 and slot IV at Warrior 20. During a completed short or long rest, equip one eligible mutation in each slot. Equipped mutations are dormant until activated unless their text explicitly says otherwise. You cannot equip the same named mutation twice.

ACTIVE MUTATIONS. Before Juggernaut Mutation Efficiency, only one equipped mutation can be active at a time. Mutation Efficiency raises the ordinary simultaneous-active limit to two. Transcendent, Apex Form and other explicit features can temporarily exceed that limit. Activating a mutation beyond the current limit ends one active mutation of your choice unless an explicit exception permits otherwise.

SERUM RESERVE. After a long rest prepare two serum doses, choosing one of the six serum profiles for each dose. At Warrior 11 the reserve becomes three prepared doses; at Warrior 20 it becomes four. Used doses do not naturally refill on a short rest. A long rest refills the reserve. Serum Recycling and explicit class features can preserve or restore doses, but no effect can increase the reserve above its current capacity.

SERUM INJECTION. Unless another feature says otherwise, injecting a prepared serum is a Bonus Action, consumes one prepared dose, activates one equipped mutation for 3 rounds and applies that dose's serum-profile benefits and side effect for the same 3 rounds. Reinjecting the same active mutation refreshes its duration rather than stacking it. Serum-profile numeric bonuses from two doses of the same profile never stack.

STRAIN. Begin after a long rest at 0 Strain; maximum Strain is 3. A normal serum injection or Mutagen Injection adds 1 Strain, Mutation Surge adds 1, and Serum Cocktail or Mutation Overload adds 2 unless modified. At Strain 2 your Speed is reduced by 5 feet. At Strain 3 you also take -1 AC and -1 on saving throws and cannot voluntarily activate another serum, Cocktail, Overclock or Surge until Strain is reduced. A completed short rest reduces Strain by 1; a long rest resets it to 0. Strain cannot exceed 3.

Mutation Adaptation and Serum Tolerance modify Strain and serum-profile side effects only as their cards state. A negative serum-profile side effect and Strain penalty are separate; preventing one does not automatically prevent the other.

BRUTALITY PROGRESS. Begin each real encounter with Brutality Progress 0 and BT 0. Add actual damage you personally deal to meaningful hostile creatures to Brutality Progress, but a single damage event contributes no more than one-quarter of your maximum HP. Crossing cumulative thresholds equal to 25%, 50% and 75% of your maximum HP grants 1 BT each, subject to the BT cap. Crossing 100% triggers Transcendent as described below but does not create a fourth stored BT unless Stack Overflow or another feature raises the cap.

TAKING DAMAGE AND BT. Once per round when one source deals you actual damage after mitigation equal to or greater than PB + M, gain 1 BT. This direct gain does not increase Brutality Progress. Normal threshold and damage-taken generation together can grant at most 2 BT per round. Explicit card gains such as Overpressure Response or Backlash Engine ignore that generation ceiling but never exceed the current BT cap.

BT CAP AND RESET. Default BT cap is 3. Stack Overflow raises it to 4. BT is not automatically spent; only features explicitly saying spend reduce it. Encounter end resets BT and Brutality Progress to 0. BT cannot be generated from friendly attacks, summoned sacrificial creatures, unattended objects, staged sparring or enemies that do not meaningfully threaten the party.

HARD CONTROL GUARD. A creature can suffer at most one Warrior-caused effect that fully denies its normal turn, such as Stunned, Paralyzed or an equivalent full-turn denial, from your Warrior features per encounter. After the first succeeds, later Warrior effects from you that would fully deny that creature's turn instead remove its Reaction and reduce its Speed to 0 until the end of its next turn after the required save fails.

ADDITIONAL ACTION GUARD. All sources share a maximum of one additional full Action per creature per round. Additional Actions cannot generate another Action, Bonus Action or Reaction. Free attacks granted by Warrior features are explicitly bounded and never recursively grant additional free attacks.

RECHARGE GUARD. A named ability may receive at most one positive-counter reset or shortening per round. Only an ability with a positive recharge counter can be reset. Recharge never restores a spent short-rest or long-rest use unless the feature explicitly says it restores that use.

HEALING AND REGENERATION. Warrior healing cannot exceed maximum HP, restore the dead or remove Wounds unless a card explicitly says otherwise. Regeneration and repeated healing effects operate only during real encounters unless their card explicitly permits downtime healing. No corpse, summoned creature, trivial enemy or friendly target can be used to create infinite healing, serum doses or BT.

IMMUNITY AND RESISTANCE. Warrior resistance does not stack with resistance to the same damage type; apply one resistance. Immunity supersedes resistance but multiple immunities provide no additional benefit. If a feature grants several immunities temporarily, each is still only one immunity to that specific type or condition.

MUTATION TIERS. Basic mutations require Warrior 1. Advanced mutations require Warrior 6. Apex mutations require Warrior 15. You may equip only mutations whose actual Warrior class-level gate and other prerequisites you meet. NEW explicit scope reconciliation (FEAT327-ACQ-02): across your single set of unlocked mutation slots, you may equip at most two Advanced mutations from each actual mutation tree and at most one Apex mutation in total across all trees. Basic mutations have no additional tier-count ceiling beyond the remaining unlocked slots. Count every equipped mutation, including a dormant one, toward its relevant equipment ceilings; use its actual source-defined tree and tier. These are equipped-loadout ceilings, not per-tree slot grants, limits on the number of feat identities acquired, or separate active-only tier ceilings. The completed-rest equipping procedure and prohibition on duplicate named mutations remain unchanged. Mutation Efficiency changes only the ordinary global simultaneous-active limit. Transcendent and Apex Form activate only the existing legally equipped loadout and do not waive equipment ceilings, level/prerequisite gates or duplicate restrictions. Apex Form's permanent slot IV is the single Warrior-20 slot unlock, not an additional slot each time the form activates. After a temporary activation exception ends, apply its exact ending procedure and the then-applicable active-mutation limit without refreshing durations or granting an unequipped mutation.

MUTATION FEATS. Mutation feats are not free mutation selections. They become eligible choices at an ASI/feat opportunity or other campaign feat grant once their listed level and mutation prerequisite are met. They do not consume mutation slots unless their own text says otherwise.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Serum Injection
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.frequency: At will while legal doses remain
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Serum Injection. Choose one equipped mutation and one prepared serum dose. Consume the dose, activate that mutation for 3 rounds and apply the serum profile for 3 rounds. Observe active-mutation limits, Strain legality and nonstacking same-profile bonuses.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Brutal Strike
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: One creature within your weapon reach
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.duration: Instantaneous; Stagger until end of target's next turn
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Brutal Strike. Make one melee weapon attack using its normal ability. On hit add S d6 damage of the weapon's type. The target makes a Constitution save; on failure it is Staggered, taking -1 on attack rolls and -5 feet Speed until the end of its next turn. This is not a full-turn denial.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Mutation Adaptation
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Mutation Adaptation. Ignore the Strain-2 Speed penalty. The first time in each encounter that activating a mutation or serum would add Strain, reduce that Strain gain by 1, minimum 0. This reduction cannot reduce Serum Cocktail or Mutation Overload below 1 Strain and cannot reduce existing Strain.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Serum Tolerance
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Serum Tolerance. Negative side effects printed on serum profiles do not affect you. Strain generation and Strain penalties still apply normally. This does not suppress drawbacks printed on mutation cards, Hero transformations or Mutation Overload.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Mutation Surge
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Mutation Surge. Enhance one active mutation. If it grants AC, DR, attack, save or flat damage, increase one such bonus by 1; if it grants movement or reach, increase it by 5 feet; if it deals mutation damage, add 1d4 to one damage event. A mutation with none of those numeric effects instead grants S temporary HP. The enhancement never changes immunity, target count or duration.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Intimidating Presence
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies of your choice within 15 feet that can see or hear you
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Intimidating Presence. Each target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it is Frightened of you until the end of its next turn, then repeats the save. A second failure extends the fear one final round. A creature that succeeds becomes immune to this use. This never forces surrender; NPC surrender remains a Director decision.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Mutation Overload
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.duration: 2 rounds; backlash until end of following turn
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Mutation Overload. For 2 rounds, enhance each currently active mutation once: an AC, DR, attack, save or flat-damage bonus increases by 1; a movement or reach bonus increases by 5 feet; or one mutation damage/healing roll gains +1d4. Immunities, target counts, resource generation and action grants cannot be increased. When Overload ends, you suffer -1 on attack rolls and saving throws and -5 feet Speed until the end of your next regular turn. This activation is illegal if +2 Strain would exceed the Strain cap.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Mutation Efficiency
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Mutation Efficiency. You may maintain up to two equipped mutations active simultaneously instead of one. Activating a third mutation while two are already active requires choosing one active mutation to become dormant unless another explicit feature temporarily raises this limit. Mutation slots, serum costs, Strain and mutation durations remain unchanged.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Combat Instinct
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Combat Instinct. Gain +1 on initiative rolls. You cannot be Surprised while conscious unless the opposing creature's Stealth check exceeds your passive Perception by 5 or more. This does not grant extra Actions or movement before combat.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Brutality Sense
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: Hostile creatures you can perceive within 60 feet
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Brutality Sense. You know when a visible hostile creature is at or below one-quarter of its maximum HP; it is Vulnerable for your Warrior features that specifically reference a marked vulnerable target. This does not reveal its exact HP or hidden resistances.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Crushing Advance
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: Self; 20-foot straight movement path and creatures crossed or approached within 5 feet
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Crushing Advance. Move up to 20 feet in a straight line without provoking opportunity attacks. Each enemy no more than one size larger whose space or reach-line you pass through or adjacent to makes a Strength save. On failure it takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage, is pushed to the nearest legal space outside your path and falls Prone. On success it takes half damage and is neither pushed nor Prone. A creature is affected once per use.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Survival Instinct
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Survival Instinct. Gain +2 on Perception checks, +2 on Dexterity saving throws and one additional Reaction usable only for Dodge-like defensive reactions, opportunity-free movement granted by a feature, or Deflect-style mitigation. It cannot make an attack or trigger another additional Reaction.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Serum Cocktail
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.cost: Consume 2 different prepared serum doses; +2 Strain
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Serum Cocktail. Choose two different prepared serum profiles, consume both doses and apply both profiles to yourself for 3 rounds while activating one eligible equipped mutation. Same-stat bonuses use only the stronger value. Both profile side effects apply unless Serum Tolerance suppresses them. This activates only one mutation and therefore differs from Serum Overclock. It is illegal if the resulting Strain would exceed 3.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Intimidating Transformation
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies of your choice within 20 feet that can see you
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Intimidating Transformation. Each target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it is Frightened of you until the end of its next turn and then repeats the save. On a failure by 10 or more, it would instead be Stunned until the end of its next turn, subject to the Warrior hard-control guard. A target succeeding on the initial save is immune to this use. The transformation does not force surrender or belief changes.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Guardian Tissue
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Guardian Tissue. When an adjacent ally would take damage, reduce that ally's incoming damage by one-third rounded down. You take the prevented amount as damage of the same type. This transferred damage cannot be redirected again and cannot trigger another Guardian Tissue. Transferred damage cannot be reduced again, redirected again or generate BT.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Bulwark Mutation Tree
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Bulwark Mutation Tree. Unlock the Wardborn-specific mutations Spinal Plating, Adrenal Overwatch and Living Cover as eligible mutation choices. They occupy normal mutation slots, require serum activation unless their card says otherwise, and obey all active-mutation, tier and Strain rules. Selecting this card does not automatically equip or activate any of them.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Mutation Slot I
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Gain one mutation slot. During a completed short or long rest, equip one eligible mutation in it. The equipped mutation remains dormant until activated unless its own text says otherwise.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Brutality Threshold Tracker
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Track Brutality Progress and BT using the common Warrior engine. Default BT cap is 3. Encounter end resets both to 0.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Mutagen Injection
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Choose Power or Guard. Power grants +2 Strength, maximum 22 from this feature. Guard grants +2 AC. This emergency mutagen does not consume a prepared serum dose and does not activate a mutation.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Mutation Slot II
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Gain a second mutation slot. This does not by itself raise the active-mutation concurrency limit.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Bone Hardened
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: While you are not Staggered, reduce physical weapon damage you take by 1 after resistance and before temporary HP.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Serum Overclock
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Inject two different prepared serum profiles simultaneously and activate up to two eligible equipped mutations, respecting your active-mutation limit. Resolve both profile effects; same-stat bonuses use the stronger. Overclock is illegal if the resulting Strain would exceed 3.
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.prerequisite: Warrior 9, Strain 1 or lower, two prepared serum doses

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Flesh Warden
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Increase maximum HP by 2 per Warrior level while equipped. Equipping raises maximum only, never current HP. Unequipping clamps current HP to the reduced maximum if necessary; it does not subtract another amount from current HP. Repeated swaps cannot heal.

currentApplicableEngineMechanicalDescrip: PROVISIONAL PLAYTEST CONTRACT. At Warrior level 1 choose Strength or Dexterity as your Warrior ability; this choice is permanent in this draft. S = 1/2/3/4 at Warrior levels 1/5/11/17. M = max(1, chosen Warrior ability modifier). Warrior technique attack = d20 + normal character proficiency bonus + chosen modifier. Warrior technique save DC = 8 + normal character proficiency bonus + chosen modifier. Source basis: approved Player Rulebook extract and preserved class registry.

MUTATION SLOTS. At Warrior 1 you have one mutation slot; slot II unlocks at Warrior 5, slot III at Warrior 13 and slot IV at Warrior 20. During a completed short or long rest, equip one eligible mutation in each slot. Equipped mutations are dormant until activated unless their text explicitly says otherwise. You cannot equip the same named mutation twice.

ACTIVE MUTATIONS. Before Juggernaut Mutation Efficiency, only one equipped mutation can be active at a time. Mutation Efficiency raises the ordinary simultaneous-active limit to two. Transcendent, Apex Form and other explicit features can temporarily exceed that limit. Activating a mutation beyond the current limit ends one active mutation of your choice unless an explicit exception permits otherwise.

SERUM RESERVE. After a long rest prepare two serum doses, choosing one of the six serum profiles for each dose. At Warrior 11 the reserve becomes three prepared doses; at Warrior 20 it becomes four. Used doses do not naturally refill on a short rest. A long rest refills the reserve. Serum Recycling and explicit class features can preserve or restore doses, but no effect can increase the reserve above its current capacity.

SERUM INJECTION. Unless another feature says otherwise, injecting a prepared serum is a Bonus Action, consumes one prepared dose, activates one equipped mutation for 3 rounds and applies that dose's serum-profile benefits and side effect for the same 3 rounds. Reinjecting the same active mutation refreshes its duration rather than stacking it. Serum-profile numeric bonuses from two doses of the same profile never stack.

STRAIN. Begin after a long rest at 0 Strain; maximum Strain is 3. A normal serum injection or Mutagen Injection adds 1 Strain, Mutation Surge adds 1, and Serum Cocktail or Mutation Overload adds 2 unless modified. At Strain 2 your Speed is reduced by 5 feet. At Strain 3 you also take -1 AC and -1 on saving throws and cannot voluntarily activate another serum, Cocktail, Overclock or Surge until Strain is reduced. A completed short rest reduces Strain by 1; a long rest resets it to 0. Strain cannot exceed 3.

Mutation Adaptation and Serum Tolerance modify Strain and serum-profile side effects only as their cards state. A negative serum-profile side effect and Strain penalty are separate; preventing one does not automatically prevent the other.

BRUTALITY PROGRESS. Begin each real encounter with Brutality Progress 0 and BT 0. Add actual damage you personally deal to meaningful hostile creatures to Brutality Progress, but a single damage event contributes no more than one-quarter of your maximum HP. Crossing cumulative thresholds equal to 25%, 50% and 75% of your maximum HP grants 1 BT each, subject to the BT cap. Crossing 100% triggers Transcendent as described below but does not create a fourth stored BT unless Stack Overflow or another feature raises the cap.

TAKING DAMAGE AND BT. Once per round when one source deals you actual damage after mitigation equal to or greater than PB + M, gain 1 BT. This direct gain does not increase Brutality Progress. Normal threshold and damage-taken generation together can grant at most 2 BT per round. Explicit card gains such as Overpressure Response or Backlash Engine ignore that generation ceiling but never exceed the current BT cap.

BT CAP AND RESET. Default BT cap is 3. Stack Overflow raises it to 4. BT is not automatically spent; only features explicitly saying spend reduce it. Encounter end resets BT and Brutality Progress to 0. BT cannot be generated from friendly attacks, summoned sacrificial creatures, unattended objects, staged sparring or enemies that do not meaningfully threaten the party.

HARD CONTROL GUARD. A creature can suffer at most one Warrior-caused effect that fully denies its normal turn, such as Stunned, Paralyzed or an equivalent full-turn denial, from your Warrior features per encounter. After the first succeeds, later Warrior effects from you that would fully deny that creature's turn instead remove its Reaction and reduce its Speed to 0 until the end of its next turn after the required save fails.

ADDITIONAL ACTION GUARD. All sources share a maximum of one additional full Action per creature per round. Additional Actions cannot generate another Action, Bonus Action or Reaction. Free attacks granted by Warrior features are explicitly bounded and never recursively grant additional free attacks.

RECHARGE GUARD. A named ability may receive at most one positive-counter reset or shortening per round. Only an ability with a positive recharge counter can be reset. Recharge never restores a spent short-rest or long-rest use unless the feature explicitly says it restores that use.

HEALING AND REGENERATION. Warrior healing cannot exceed maximum HP, restore the dead or remove Wounds unless a card explicitly says otherwise. Regeneration and repeated healing effects operate only during real encounters unless their card explicitly permits downtime healing. No corpse, summoned creature, trivial enemy or friendly target can be used to create infinite healing, serum doses or BT.

IMMUNITY AND RESISTANCE. Warrior resistance does not stack with resistance to the same damage type; apply one resistance. Immunity supersedes resistance but multiple immunities provide no additional benefit. If a feature grants several immunities temporarily, each is still only one immunity to that specific type or condition.

Transcendent and Apex Form activate only the existing legally equipped loadout and do not waive equipment ceilings, level/prerequisite gates or duplicate restrictions. Apex Form's permanent slot IV is the single Warrior-20 slot unlock, not an additional slot each time the form activates. After a temporary activation exception ends, apply its exact ending procedure and the then-applicable active-mutation limit without refreshing durations or granting an unequipped mutation.

MUTATION FEATS. Mutation feats are not free mutation selections. They become eligible choices at an ASI/feat opportunity or other campaign feat grant once their listed level and mutation prerequisite are met. They do not consume mutation slots unless their own text says otherwise.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Druidic
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Know Druidic. Other speakers notice and read your hidden Druidic messages. Nonspeakers notice their presence on WIS Perception DC 15 but need translation magic or learning the language to read them.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Spellcasting
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Prepare and cast according to the engine. WIS attack/DC; rank gates, components, concentration, Dissonance and RP apply. This entry creates no extra actions or second resource pool.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Shapeshifting
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Assume an unlocked prepared form or revert early. Apply engine HP, equipment, concentration and reserve rules. This is not a spell and cannot copy monster stat blocks.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Wolf Form (Striker)
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Speed 40 ft; advantage on hearing/smell Perception. Bite 1d8 piercing+WIS; target STR save against Druid DC or Prone, once/target/round. All damage remains your own HP.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Bear Form (Tank)
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.cost: One shift; buffer drawn from reserve
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Gain up to 20 temporary HP from reserve; AC max(normal, 14). Claw 2d6 slashing+WIS+1. Buffer disappears on reversion and cannot be refilled through free shifting.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Hawk Form (Scout)
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Tiny, flight 60 ft, walking 10 ft, advantage on sight Perception. Talon 1d4 slashing+WIS; advantage if you descended at least 10 ft immediately before attack. No carrying Medium allies or casting spells before 18.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Boar Form (Brawler)
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Resistance to slashing. Tusk 1d6 piercing+WIS. After moving 10 ft directly toward target, first hit/turn adds 1d6 and STR save or push 5 ft; no repeated charges from forced movement.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Panther Form (Stealth)
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Speed 40 ft, darkvision 60 ft, +4 Stealth. Claw 2d4 slashing+WIS; after 20 ft straight approach hit, STR save or Grappled. Escape Action against Druid DC; ends on separation/reversion. Only one held target, no free Restrained.

currentApplicableEngineMechanicalDescrip: Wisdom governs spells, form attacks and class DC/M. Hit Die d8; book armor, weapons, saves and skills remain. Retain your own ability scores, HP, saves, proficiency and personality in all forms; form traits replace only the stated anatomy, movement and attacks. No additional monster stat block or separate beast HP pool. One natural attack per Attack Action unless a form explicitly states otherwise, attack PB+WIS, printed dice+WIS damage. Missing natural attack is 1d6 bludgeoning; default walking Speed 30 ft, normal AC, Medium size. Hawk is Tiny, Bear/Earth Warden/hero forms may be Large when space permits. Equipment melds and cannot be used while melded; magical numeric bonuses persist only if compatible with form anatomy and never duplicate armor.

Preparation: two cantrips at 1, three at 4, four at 10, plus explicit Circle bonuses. Prepare class level+WIS modifier ranked Druid spells (minimum 1) each long rest, rank limited by Druid spell-rank access, not merely by enough RP. Use approved operational spell entries and Core V 2 RP table/costs in the shared configuration. Book rank-times-two cost and imported spell-slot terminology are preserved as superseded alternatives for this pilot. Circle always-prepared spells do not count toward preparation and use ordinary RP/Dissonance. Rituals must have ritual tag, be prepared and take printed casting time plus 10 minutes; waive base RP only, never consumed materials or other costs. ASI/feat milestones 4/8/12/16/19 belong to general advancement and must not be granted twice.

Shifting: Bonus Action, one long-rest shift use, 10 minutes, early reversion Bonus Action. Reaching 0 HP or incapacitation ends form; excess damage stays on your own HP. Shift uses follow detailed book table:2 at 1, 3 at 4, 4 at 7, 5 at 10, 6 at 13, 7 at 16, 8 at 19. Supplemental runtime alternative 2/3/4/5/6 at 1/4/8/12/16 remains preserved. At 20 changing form is unlimited but does not refill finite form benefits. Speech unavailable in Base forms, available in Arch/Hero. No spellcasting in form until Beast Spells 18 except an explicit form permission. Maintaining an existing spell concentration is allowed, still only one concentration. Changing form spends a use and ends old form features/summons; it does not reset once/rest abilities.

Transformation reserves prevent unlimited replacement HP: at long rest record Buffer Reserve=2 L+M and Form Surge Reserve=PB. A form giving temporary HP draws that many from Buffer Reserve, up to remaining amount, with normal nonstacking; never real healing. A form special described once/transformation also spends 1 Form Surge and cannot be refreshed by resuming the form. Form Surge refills only long rest. Forms cannot grant free casts, RP or shift uses. Auras affect at most 3 enemies and once per enemy per round; retaliation once/round total; ongoing riders refresh, never stack. Entering a legal Shapeshift clears the Refrain counter and remembered repeated-spell name, as the protected source contract requires. It does not reduce accumulated Dissonance. Natural attacks do not clear Refrain.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Arcane Bolt
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Arcane Bolt. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, universal, damage. Make a Wizard spell attack. On a hit deal S d6 + M force damage. Arcane Bolt is an always-prepared class matrix once acquired and uses the normal first-distinct-matrix and Refrain rules.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Arcane Shield
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Arcane Shield. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, abjuration, protection. Trigger when an attack roll would hit you. Gain +2 AC against the triggering attack and until the start of your next regular turn, potentially causing the attack to miss. Temporary AC from another Arcane Shield does not stack.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Arcane Insight
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Arcane Insight. Tags: base, passive, knowledge. Gain proficiency in Arcana, or expertise if already proficient. When examining an active magical effect, spell residue, magic item or arcane construction, you may make an Intelligence (Arcana) check to determine its broad school, function or unusual matrix behavior. The Director sets the normal knowledge DC; failure supplies no invented fact.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Spell Scribing
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Spell Scribing. Tags: base, passive, spellbook. Copying a legal found Wizard spell into your spellbook requires 1 hour and 25 gp of inks and components per spell rank, treating rank 0 as rank 1 for this calculation, instead of the pilot baseline 2 hours and 50 gp. Level-up spells remain free.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Spellbook Study
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Spellbook Study. Tags: base, active, matrix, ritual. Replace one currently prepared matrix with one legal spell recorded in your spellbook. The replacement must be within your Wizard rank limit. This is the normal midday substitution permission; it does not alter the spellbook, create another prepared-matrix position or reset first-cast/Refrain history for an underlying matrix family already cast this encounter.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Scholarly Mind
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Scholarly Mind. Tags: base, passive, knowledge. You have advantage on Intelligence checks whose primary purpose is recalling, researching or analyzing arcane theory, magical history, planar magical principles or constructed spell formulae. It does not grant advantage on spell attacks, Counterspell checks or general Investigation unrelated to arcane scholarship.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Arcane Sight
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Arcane Sight. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, divination, concentration. While active you perceive magical auras within 60 feet and automatically know each visible aura's school or broad magical category. As an Action on a later turn, examine one aura to learn whether it is concentrated, summoned, cursed, warded or linked to another visible magical effect. Total cover blocks sight.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Sigil Rewrite
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Sigil Rewrite. Tags: arch, passive-upgrade, matrix. Replace one prepared matrix with a different spell from your spellbook of exactly the same rank without performing the normal 10-minute ritual. The replacement receives no special Dissonance reset for a matrix family already used this encounter and must obey current Wizard rank eligibility.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Matrix Efficiency
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Matrix Efficiency. Tags: base, passive, matrix. Your normal full daily Spell Matrix preparation time is reduced from 1 hour to 45 minutes. This does not reduce the separate 10-minute midday substitution ritual, spell scribing, rituals or spellbook reconstruction unless another feature explicitly says so.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Matrix Mastery
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Matrix Mastery. Tags: arch, passive, matrix. During preparation you may assign at most one common Matrix Mastery modification to each ordinary prepared spell: Quick Substitution, Component Enhancement, Matrix Linking or Stability Reinforcement, using the exact common definitions in the Wizard engine. Always-prepared class-card matrices cannot receive these modifications unless a card explicitly says otherwise.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Floating Preparation
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Floating Preparation. Tags: arch, passive, matrix. Increase your maximum prepared Spell Matrix count by 1. The extra matrix can come from any school and obeys all ordinary spellbook and rank restrictions. It is a prepared matrix for every rule, including protected strain, duplicate-family tracking and Matrix Mastery modifications.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Spell Tether
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Spell Tether. Tags: arch, passive-upgrade, concentration, tether. When you begin a second concentration spell that targets only yourself while already concentrating on a self-only spell, spend 3 additional RP. For up to 3 rounds you may maintain both. Whenever damage requires a concentration save, make one save; failure ends BOTH spells. Starting a third concentration effect ends both tethered spells before the new one begins. Spell Tether and Tethered Cast cannot be combined; maximum two sustained concentration effects total. Only one Spell Tether can exist at a time.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Improved Concentration
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Improved Concentration. Tags: arch, passive, concentration. You have advantage on Constitution saving throws made because damage threatens your concentration on a Wizard spell. This does not alter the DC, protect a Tether from rules that explicitly end both effects, or prevent Silence, incapacitation and other non-damage concentration failures.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Dispel Magic
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: One creature, object or magical effect within 60 feet
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Dispel Magic. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, abjuration. Choose one ongoing spell effect you can perceive. If its rank is 3 or lower, end it. If it is rank 4 or higher, make an Intelligence check adding proficiency against DC 10 + spell rank; success ends it. Permanent artifact properties and effects explicitly immune to dispelling are unaffected.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Flesh Ascendant
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Flesh Ascendant. Tags: hero, necromancer, passive, undead. Each undead creature you control gains +2 maximum HP per Wizard class level. While at least two of your undead creatures are active, each also gains +1 AC and +1 on saving throws. These bonuses apply after the common standard-minion and elite-pet statistics and do not increase companion caps or command frequency.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Corpse Harvest
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: One eligible humanoid corpse within 30 feet
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.duration: Until destroyed, dismissed or your next long rest
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Corpse Harvest. Tags: hero, necromancer, wizard-spell, undead, summon. Raise the corpse as a Skeleton or Zombie using the common standard-undead statistics; a goblinoid corpse may instead become a Goblin Thrall. The corpse is consumed into that minion state. The creature obeys the shared Bonus Action Companion Command rule. Creating a fourth standard minion requires dismissing one existing standard minion first.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Arcane Lock
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: One door, chest, portal or unattended object within touch
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Arcane Lock. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, abjuration. Magically seal the target. Opening it without your permission requires a Strength check or thieves'/arcane-tool check against your Wizard spell DC. Dispel Magic can end the lock. You can designate up to M creatures who can bypass it. This does not make the object physically indestructible.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Mind Matrix
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Mind Matrix. Tags: hero, necromancer, passive, enchantment. Increase your Wizard save DC by 2 for Enchantment spells. This stacks with your level-1 school bonus only if Enchantment is your Arcane School. It does not increase DCs for non-spell class techniques merely because they influence a creature's mind.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Dimensional Pocket
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Dimensional Pocket. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, conjuration, ritual. Create an extradimensional storage space holding up to 100 pounds or 10 cubic feet of unattended nonliving material. Retrieving or placing an item while adjacent to the opening uses an object interaction. Living creatures cannot enter. When duration ends, remaining contents appear harmlessly in the nearest unoccupied space.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Arcane Tradition
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.frequency: Automatic at Wizard 3; not a selection
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Arcane Tradition. Tags: arch, school, automatic. Your level-1 Arcane School becomes your Arcanist tradition; do not choose a second school. Prepare one additional matrix from that same school each day without counting it against your normal prepared-matrix maximum. It otherwise obeys all ordinary rank, spellbook, Dissonance and duplicate-family rules.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Counterspell
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: One creature you perceive casting a spell within 60 feet
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Counterspell. Tags: arch-source, automatic, wizard-spell, abjuration, disruption. Trigger when a creature begins casting a spell. Make an Intelligence check adding proficiency against DC 10 + twice the spell's rank, treating rank 0 as 0. Success negates the triggering spell after its costs are paid; failure lets it resolve. This is gained automatically at Wizard 2 and is never also selected from the Arch pool.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Ritual Casting
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.cost: 0 RP unless the individual ritual explicitly states otherwise
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.frequency: At will outside encounters with sufficient time
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Cast a Wizard spell bearing the Ritual tag directly from your spellbook without preparing it. Increase its casting time by at least 10 minutes. Ritual Casting cannot be completed during an encounter, does not use an ordinary prepared-matrix position and does not generate or vent normal casting Dissonance.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: School Mastery
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: This is the one School Mastery progression grant, not a second school choice or duplicate feat. Increase the level-1 Arcane School spell-attack and spell-save bonus from +1 to +2 total. Its school passive and bonus-spell rules otherwise remain unchanged.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Arcane Ward
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: After preparing spells, choose one of acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, psychic, radiant or thunder that is dealt by at least one prepared spell of your Arcane School. Gain resistance to that damage type until your next long rest. If none of your prepared school spells deals a damage type, choose force. This is provisional completion of the source's ambiguous 'chosen school's element' wording.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Dual Cast
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.cost: Pay the complete RP costs of both spells
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Choose two DIFFERENT prepared Wizard spells of rank 1 or 2, neither of which summons a creature or grants an additional Action. Cast both sequentially as one Action, paying both RP costs. They cannot both require concentration. Each matrix separately updates first-cast/Refrain history. Features that trigger merely from 'casting a spell' may trigger once for each actual matrix unless that feature itself says once per turn; no trigger may create another Dual Cast or additional full Action.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Overchannel
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.cost: Pay the Core V 2 RP cost for one rank above the spell's normal cast rank
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: One prepared spell you are beginning to cast
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Cast one prepared spell as though it were one rank higher than the highest rank at which you could normally cast that SAME spell, provided the spell has an explicit higher-rank scaling rule. Overchannel does not teach or prepare a higher-rank spell, cannot exceed effective rank 9 and cannot be combined with another generic Overcast rule during this pilot. All normal Dissonance/Refrain rules still apply.

currentApplicableEngineMechanicalDescrip: PROVISIONAL PLAYTEST CONTRACT. Intelligence is the Wizard class ability. S = 1/2/3/4 at Wizard levels 1/5/11/17. M = max(1, Intelligence modifier). Wizard spell attack = d20 + normal character proficiency bonus + Intelligence modifier. Wizard spell save DC = 8 + normal character proficiency bonus + Intelligence modifier.

SPELLBOOK. At Wizard 1 your spellbook contains six chosen rank-1 Wizard spells. Arcane School Specialization also adds one legal rank-1 bonus spell of your chosen school without replacing one of those six. For this provisional progression, add 2 legal Wizard spells to the book at each Wizard level 2-4, 3 at each level 5-8, 4 at each level 9-12, 5 at each level 13-16 and 6 at each level 17-20. Level-up additions cost no money or scribing time.

LEGAL RANKS. Maximum Wizard spell rank by Wizard class level is: rank 1 at levels 1-2, rank 2 at 3-4, rank 3 at 5-6, rank 4 at 7-8, rank 5 at 9-10, rank 6 at 11-12, rank 7 at 13-14, rank 8 at 15-16 and rank 9 at 17-20. Grand Tier at level 20 is a special casting permission, not a tenth ordinary rank. A Wizard may learn Wizard-list spells from any school up to the legal rank unless a spell itself has an additional prerequisite.

PREPARED SPELL MATRIX. After a long rest, prepare a number of matrices equal to Wizard level + Intelligence modifier, minimum 1, selecting only spells currently recorded in your spellbook and within your legal rank. You cast ordinary Wizard spells only from prepared matrices unless a feature explicitly overrides that restriction. Preparing the full daily matrix set normally requires 1 hour of spellbook study. Matrix Efficiency reduces this to 45 minutes.

DUPLICATE PREPARATION. You may prepare the same spell more than once, primarily to carry different Matrix Mastery configurations. Duplicate copies never create additional first-cast Dissonance exemptions. For Refrain and the protected strain rule, all prepared copies sharing the same underlying spell name belong to one matrix family regardless of modification.

MIDDAY SUBSTITUTION. Once between long rests, you may perform a 10-minute Spellbook Study ritual to replace one prepared matrix with another legal spell from your spellbook. The replacement cannot exceed your legal Wizard rank. Sigil Rewrite and Matrix Mastery may improve this process as explicitly stated.

SPELL ACQUISITION BY SCRIBING. A found Wizard spell may be copied into the spellbook if its rank is legal for you. Baseline scribing requires 2 hours and 50 gp of inks/materials per spell rank, treating rank 0 as 1 for this calculation. Spell Scribing halves both values to 1 hour and 25 gp per rank. Failure to finish the work consumes no spellbook entry but materials already expended during an interrupted hour are lost.

SPELLBOOK LOSS. Losing the spellbook does not erase matrices currently prepared in memory; you may continue casting those prepared matrices until you next rebuild or change preparation. A blank replacement book can be seeded with your currently prepared spells at 1 hour and 25 gp per effective spell rank each. An unprepared spell you previously recorded can be reconstructed from memory with 8 hours, 100 gp per rank and an Intelligence (Arcana) check against DC 10 + spell rank. Failure consumes that attempt's time and half its materials; another attempt can be made after a long rest. Recovering the original book automatically restores access to its surviving entries.

Core Systems V 2 Resonance Points and spell-rank RP costs are authoritative for Wizard spellcasting. There are no historical spell slots in this pilot. Wizard cards tagged wizard-spell are always-prepared class matrices once acquired, do not consume a daily prepared-matrix position and use the same RP, concentration, Refrain and protected first-distinct-matrix rules as other Wizard spells. Their printed RP cost replaces any generic rank cost; never pay both.

RITUAL CASTING is automatic at Wizard 2. A Wizard spell in your spellbook with the Ritual tag can be cast from the book without being prepared by increasing its casting time by at least 10 minutes. A ritual cast costs 0 RP unless that ritual explicitly lists a consumed RP cost, cannot be used during an encounter and cannot generate or vent Dissonance through ordinary casting strain.

MATRIX MASTERY MODIFICATIONS. After acquiring Matrix Mastery, each prepared ordinary spell matrix may carry at most one modification chosen during preparation. QUICK SUBSTITUTION: once per short rest, replace one matrix marked Quick Substitution with another spellbook spell of exactly the same rank using a 1-minute ritual instead of the normal 10-minute midday swap; the replacement loses the modification until the next long rest. COMPONENT ENHANCEMENT: when casting a damaging or healing matrix, spend 1 additional RP to add one extra die of the spell's primary damage or healing die to one roll; if the spell has no such die this modification has no effect. MATRIX LINKING: pair two different prepared matrix families during preparation; after legally casting one, the other costs 1 less RP, minimum 1, if cast before the end of your next regular turn, at most once per pair per round. STABILITY REINFORCEMENT: gain +2 on concentration saves caused by damage while maintaining that matrix. A matrix modification never creates another spell cast or proc event.

Round recharge counters decrease once at the start of your regular initiative turn even if you cannot act. Extra Actions and extra turns do not tick recharge. Outside initiative, each uninterrupted 6 seconds counts as one tick. Only positive counters can be reset or shortened and each named ability can receive at most one reset or shortening per round.

SUMMON COMMAND LIMIT. All Wizard-controlled conjured, raised and bound companions share one damaging/control Companion Command per Wizard regular turn. Spend one Bonus Action to command exactly one such creature to move up to its Speed and use one damaging or control action from its stat block. Uncommanded creatures may reposition defensively and take Dodge but cannot deal damage or impose conditions. No summoned or raised creature can create XP, treasure, RP, Dissonance relief, additional corpses or kill-resource farms.

NECROMANCER STANDARD UNDEAD. Corpse Harvest and Auto-Raise share a maximum of three standard raised minions. Skeleton: AC 14, HP 6 + 2 × Wizard level, Speed 30; Bone Shot, range 30 feet, Wizard spell attack, 1d6+S necrotic. Zombie: AC 12, HP 10 + 3 × Wizard level, Speed 20; Slam, reach 5 feet, Wizard spell attack, 1d8+S necrotic. Goblin Thrall, available only from a goblinoid corpse: AC 13, HP 8 + 2 × Wizard level, Speed 30; Shiv, reach 5 feet, Wizard spell attack, 1d6+S necrotic. These are pre-Flesh-Ascendant statistics.

NECROMANCER AUTO-RAISE. Once per round when one of your standard undead minions personally lands the killing blow on an eligible humanoid and your standard-minion count is below three, its corpse rises at the end of the current turn as the same mechanical minion type that scored the kill, if physically possible. A new minion cannot act during that same round. Auto-Raise costs no Action or RP but can never exceed the three-minion cap or generate a new resource, corpse chain, XP or treasure event. Without Infernal Pact only humanoids qualify.

ELITE UNDEAD PETS. Necromancers may bind Boneflayer, Dreadblade and Wraithbound, at most one of each and three elite pets total. They use the same shared Companion Command limit as standard undead. Boneflayer: AC 14, HP 12 + 2 × Wizard level, Speed 30. Bone Shards: range 60, Wizard spell attack, 2d6+S necrotic. Fear Pulse replaces its attack: enemies within 10 feet make Wisdom saves; failure Frightened until end of next turn; recharge 3. Grave Miasma replaces its attack: 10-foot-radius point within 30 feet until start of your next turn; enemies entering or starting there take 1d6 necrotic once; recharge 3.

Dreadblade: AC 16, HP 16 + 3 × Wizard level, Speed 30. Disrupting Blade: reach 5 feet, Wizard spell attack, 1d8+S necrotic; a concentrating target immediately makes its concentration save with disadvantage. On a natural 20 the target is Weakened until the end of its next turn, taking -1 on attack rolls. Dreadblade has advantage on saves against forced movement.

Wraithbound: AC 14, HP 10 + 2 × Wizard level, Fly 40 and hover. While it has not attacked or imposed control since the end of its previous turn it is Invisible; attacking ends that state until the end of its next turn. Wraith Strike: reach 5 feet, Wizard spell attack, 1d8+S necrotic. On natural 20 the target makes a Constitution save against your Wizard DC; failure Stuns until the end of its next turn.

Flesh Ascendant's bonus applies after the listed base statistics: every undead creature you control gains +2 maximum HP per Wizard level. If at least two of your undead creatures are active, each gains +1 AC and +1 on saving throws. This does not increase the standard-minion or elite-pet caps.

DARK-TRAUMA INTERFACE. Necromancer features involving corpse desecration, infernal bargains, domination, body control or Mind Prison remain subject to the project's existing dark-content and trauma boundaries. A table may fade description to black without changing mechanics. No feature changes a player's real belief, permanently transfers ownership of a player character or silently retires a PC.

Arcane Bolt is an always-prepared class matrix once acquired and uses the normal first-distinct-matrix and Refrain rules.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Arcane Shield
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Arcane Shield. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, abjuration, protection. Trigger when an attack roll would hit you. Gain +2 AC against the triggering attack and until the start of your next regular turn, potentially causing the attack to miss. Temporary AC from another Arcane Shield does not stack.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Arcane Insight
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Arcane Insight. Tags: base, passive, knowledge. Gain proficiency in Arcana, or expertise if already proficient. When examining an active magical effect, spell residue, magic item or arcane construction, you may make an Intelligence (Arcana) check to determine its broad school, function or unusual matrix behavior. The Director sets the normal knowledge DC; failure supplies no invented fact.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Spell Scribing

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Spellbook Study
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Spellbook Study. Tags: base, active, matrix, ritual. Replace one currently prepared matrix with one legal spell recorded in your spellbook. The replacement must be within your Wizard rank limit. This is the normal midday substitution permission; it does not alter the spellbook, create another prepared-matrix position or reset first-cast/Refrain history for an underlying matrix family already cast this encounter.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Scholarly Mind
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Scholarly Mind. Tags: base, passive, knowledge. You have advantage on Intelligence checks whose primary purpose is recalling, researching or analyzing arcane theory, magical history, planar magical principles or constructed spell formulae. It does not grant advantage on spell attacks, Counterspell checks or general Investigation unrelated to arcane scholarship.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Arcane Sight
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Arcane Sight. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, divination, concentration. While active you perceive magical auras within 60 feet and automatically know each visible aura's school or broad magical category. As an Action on a later turn, examine one aura to learn whether it is concentrated, summoned, cursed, warded or linked to another visible magical effect. Total cover blocks sight.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Sigil Rewrite
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Sigil Rewrite. Tags: arch, passive-upgrade, matrix. Replace one prepared matrix with a different spell from your spellbook of exactly the same rank without performing the normal 10-minute ritual. The replacement receives no special Dissonance reset for a matrix family already used this encounter and must obey current Wizard rank eligibility.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Matrix Efficiency
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Matrix Efficiency. Tags: base, passive, matrix. Your normal full daily Spell Matrix preparation time is reduced from 1 hour to 45 minutes. actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Matrix Mastery

It is a prepared matrix for every rule, including protected strain, duplicate-family tracking and Matrix Mastery modifications.

A blank replacement book can be seeded with your currently prepared spells at 1 hour and 25 gp per effective spell rank each. An unprepared spell you previously recorded can be reconstructed from memory with 8 hours, 100 gp per rank and an Intelligence (Arcana) check against DC 10 + spell rank. Failure consumes that attempt's time and half its materials; another attempt can be made after a long rest. Recovering the original book automatically restores access to its surviving entries.

Core Systems V 2 Resonance Points and spell-rank RP costs are authoritative for Wizard spellcasting. There are no historical spell slots in this pilot. Wizard cards tagged wizard-spell are always-prepared class matrices once acquired, do not consume a daily prepared-matrix position and use the same RP, concentration, Refrain and protected first-distinct-matrix rules as other Wizard spells. Their printed RP cost replaces any generic rank cost; never pay both.

RITUAL CASTING is automatic at Wizard 2. A Wizard spell in your spellbook with the Ritual tag can be cast from the book without being prepared by increasing its casting time by at least 10 minutes. A ritual cast costs 0 RP unless that ritual explicitly lists a consumed RP cost, cannot be used during an encounter and cannot generate or vent Dissonance through ordinary casting strain.

MATRIX MASTERY MODIFICATIONS. After acquiring Matrix Mastery, each prepared ordinary spell matrix may carry at most one modification chosen during preparation. QUICK SUBSTITUTION: once per short rest, replace one matrix marked Quick Substitution with another spellbook spell of exactly the same rank using a 1-minute ritual instead of the normal 10-minute midday swap; the replacement loses the modification until the next long rest. COMPONENT ENHANCEMENT: when casting a damaging or healing matrix, spend 1 additional RP to add one extra die of the spell's primary damage or healing die to one roll; if the spell has no such die this modification has no effect. MATRIX LINKING: pair two different prepared matrix families during preparation; after legally casting one, the other costs 1 less RP, minimum 1, if cast before the end of your next regular turn, at most once per pair per round. STABILITY REINFORCEMENT: gain +2 on concentration saves caused by damage while maintaining that matrix. A matrix modification never creates another spell cast or proc event.

Round recharge counters decrease once at the start of your regular initiative turn even if you cannot act. Extra Actions and extra turns do not tick recharge. Outside initiative, each uninterrupted 6 seconds counts as one tick. Only positive counters can be reset or shortened and each named ability can receive at most one reset or shortening per round.

SUMMON COMMAND LIMIT. All Wizard-controlled conjured, raised and bound companions share one damaging/control Companion Command per Wizard regular turn. Spend one Bonus Action to command exactly one such creature to move up to its Speed and use one damaging or control action from its stat block. Uncommanded creatures may reposition defensively and take Dodge but cannot deal damage or impose conditions. No summoned or raised creature can create XP, treasure, RP, Dissonance relief, additional corpses or kill-resource farms.

NECROMANCER STANDARD UNDEAD. Corpse Harvest and Auto-Raise share a maximum of three standard raised minions. Skeleton: AC 14, HP 6 + 2 × Wizard level, Speed 30; Bone Shot, range 30 feet, Wizard spell attack, 1d6+S necrotic. Zombie: AC 12, HP 10 + 3 × Wizard level, Speed 20; Slam, reach 5 feet, Wizard spell attack, 1d8+S necrotic. Goblin Thrall, available only from a goblinoid corpse: AC 13, HP 8 + 2 × Wizard level, Speed 30; Shiv, reach 5 feet, Wizard spell attack, 1d6+S necrotic. These are pre-Flesh-Ascendant statistics.

NECROMANCER AUTO-RAISE. Once per round when one of your standard undead minions personally lands the killing blow on an eligible humanoid and your standard-minion count is below three, its corpse rises at the end of the current turn as the same mechanical minion type that scored the kill, if physically possible. A new minion cannot act during that same round. Auto-Raise costs no Action or RP but can never exceed the three-minion cap or generate a new resource, corpse chain, XP or treasure event. Without Infernal Pact only humanoids qualify.

ELITE UNDEAD PETS. Necromancers may bind Boneflayer, Dreadblade and Wraithbound, at most one of each and three elite pets total. They use the same shared Companion Command limit as standard undead. Boneflayer: AC 14, HP 12 + 2 × Wizard level, Speed 30. Bone Shards: range 60, Wizard spell attack, 2d6+S necrotic. Fear Pulse replaces its attack: enemies within 10 feet make Wisdom saves; failure Frightened until end of next turn; recharge 3. Grave Miasma replaces its attack: 10-foot-radius point within 30 feet until start of your next turn; enemies entering or starting there take 1d6 necrotic once; recharge 3.

Dreadblade: AC 16, HP 16 + 3 × Wizard level, Speed 30. Disrupting Blade: reach 5 feet, Wizard spell attack, 1d8+S necrotic; a concentrating target immediately makes its concentration save with disadvantage. On a natural 20 the target is Weakened until the end of its next turn, taking -1 on attack rolls. Dreadblade has advantage on saves against forced movement.

Wraithbound: AC 14, HP 10 + 2 × Wizard level, Fly 40 and hover. While it has not attacked or imposed control since the end of its previous turn it is Invisible; attacking ends that state until the end of its next turn. Wraith Strike: reach 5 feet, Wizard spell attack, 1d8+S necrotic. On natural 20 the target makes a Constitution save against your Wizard DC; failure Stuns until the end of its next turn.

A table may fade description to black without changing mechanics. No feature changes a player's real belief, permanently transfers ownership of a player character or silently retires a PC.
