actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Judgment
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.frequency: Automatic only if Judgment was selected
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Invocation Path — Judgment. Tags: invocation, judgment, smite. When your Divine Smite deals damage to a creature, mark it Judged for 2 rounds. A Judged creature has -1 AC. Further applications refresh the duration but do not increase the AC penalty.

currentApplicableEngineMechanicalDescrip: PROVISIONAL PLAYTEST CONTRACT. Wisdom is the Cleric class ability. S = 1/2/3/4 at Cleric levels 1/5/11/17. M = max(1, Wisdom modifier) unless a feature explicitly substitutes another ability. Cleric technique attack = d20 + normal character proficiency bonus + Wisdom modifier. Cleric technique save DC = 8 + normal character proficiency bonus + Wisdom modifier.

Conviction is separate from Resonance Points. Base Conviction maximum is 3, automatically becoming 5 at Cleric 9; after a long rest you begin at your current maximum. A completed short rest restores 1 spent Conviction, to the maximum. A completed long rest restores all Conviction. Conviction Pool raises the maximum by 2. Conviction persists between encounters; simply declaring prayer, repeating a Rite, or performing harmless actions outside a real encounter never generates Conviction.

Only explicit features generate Conviction. Sacred Chant, Sermon of Purpose, Doctrine Shield, Dark Conviction and other printed cards are valid generators. A feature cannot generate more Conviction than its text permits, and Conviction can never exceed the current maximum. Summoned creatures, friendly creatures, trivial creatures, repeated corpse manipulation and staged out-of-combat actions cannot be used to farm Conviction.

Cleric techniques use only their printed RP and Conviction costs. All RP is paid from the Cleric's Core Systems V 2 Resonance Point pool. A Cleric technique is not automatically an ordinary spell-rank cast and does not receive Overcast, spell-slot, cost-discount or spell-proc benefits unless a feature explicitly says otherwise. Ordinary spells continue to use Core V 2 spellcasting rules.

Protected Dissonance interaction: once on each of your regular turns, when you spend at least 2 Conviction on a Rite or Invocation, reduce Dissonance by 1, minimum 0. The expenditure must actually occur; waived Conviction costs do not vent Dissonance. A single feature expenditure vents at most once even if it spends more than 2 Conviction. No Cleric card automatically adds Dissonance unless explicitly written.

One concentration effect may be maintained at a time. Starting another concentration effect immediately ends the previous one. Damage uses the current Core Systems concentration rule; for this pilot, if a division requires rounding, half damage is rounded down. Sustained Cleric effects use their printed maintenance cost and Bonus Action. A control effect that persists for multiple pulses or rounds gives the target a new save at each printed pulse or at the end of each affected turn as stated.

Round recharge counters are set after resolution and decrease once at the start of the Cleric's regular initiative turn, even if the Cleric cannot act. Extra Actions and extra turns do not create extra recharge ticks. Outside initiative, each uninterrupted 6 seconds counts as one recharge tick. Only a positive counter may be reset or shortened, and a named ability can receive at most one reset or shortening per round.

Healing cannot exceed maximum HP, does not remove Wounds, and does not restore a dead creature unless a card explicitly says it resurrects. No Cleric feature provides unlimited permanent HP or resource restoration outside encounters. Temporary HP does not stack with itself; use the higher value. Resurrection and corpse-based effects have explicit use limits and cannot generate repeatable corpses, XP, loot or Conviction.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Healing Rite
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Healing Rite. Tags: rite, healing. One living ally regains S d8 + M HP. It cannot restore a dead creature or remove Wounds. Consecrated Ground and appropriate Invocation Path bonuses may modify this healing.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Conviction Pool
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Conviction Pool. Tags: conviction, passive. Increase your Conviction maximum by 2. This changes only the maximum; it does not immediately restore spent Conviction when acquired during play. A long rest restores Conviction to the new maximum.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Consecrated Ground
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Consecrated Ground. Tags: rite, healing, passive. Whenever one of your healing Rites restores HP to a living creature standing in terrain created by your Consecrate feature, that creature regains S additional HP. Apply this once per creature per Rite pulse; it is flat healing and is not itself another healing trigger.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Judging Light
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Judging Light. Tags: smite, passive. actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Fervent Ritualist

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: Allies within 15 feet who can perceive you
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Aura of Faith. Tags: aura, bishop. Allies in the aura gain +1 on saving throws. Whenever your Rite restores HP to an ally in the aura, that ally also regains 1 additional HP. Multiple Aura of Faith bonuses do not stack.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Sacred Chant
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Sacred Chant. Tags: chant, sustained, conviction. Pulse on start and once when maintained on each later regular turn with a Bonus Action. Under the base feature, the third pulse generates 1 Conviction. Only a real encounter can generate Conviction this way. Maintenance itself does not otherwise heal, damage or grant Conviction.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Consecrate
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: 15-foot-radius fixed zone centered at a point within 30 feet
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Consecrate. Tags: rite, zone. Create sanctified terrain. Your Consecrated Ground feature recognizes this zone. Undead creatures in the zone have -1 on attack rolls. A creature leaving the zone loses that penalty immediately. Only one Consecrate zone created by you may exist at a time; creating another ends the first.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Divine Insight
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: Self; subject matter concerning a religious matter, sacred location or divine presence
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Divine Insight. Tags: ritual, information. Ask the Director one specific factual question about a religious practice, sacred location, divine presence or recognized supernatural sign available to your tradition. Receive one truthful fact, symbolic clue or 'unknown' if the information is genuinely unavailable. This never forces certainty about future events or another character's private beliefs.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Sermon of Purpose
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Sermon of Purpose. Tags: chant, conviction, bishop. Sacred Chant generates its 1 Conviction on its second pulse instead of its third. A normal three-pulse Sacred Chant still generates only 1 Conviction total unless another feature explicitly extends it or grants an additional generation event.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Liturgical Flow
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Liturgical Flow. Tags: rite, invocation, recharge. If you start Rites on two consecutive regular turns, your next Divine Invocation started before the end of your following regular turn sets its printed round-recharge counter 1 lower, minimum 0. This counts as Divine Invocation's one allowed reset or shortening for that round.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Anointed Guardian
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: First ally within 30 feet to fall to one-quarter maximum HP or less
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Anointed Guardian. Tags: protection, bishop. The first qualifying ally in an encounter gains a ward for 2 rounds. The first time during each round that ally takes damage, reduce that damage by PB + M, minimum 0. The ward does not prevent conditions attached to an attack unless the damage reduction itself invalidates them under another rule.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Invocation Attunement
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Invocation Attunement. Tags: invocation, core. At Cleric level 2 choose exactly one Invocation Path: Radiance, Judgment, Renewal, Flame, Veil or Echoes. You automatically gain that path's listed bonus. Divine Invocation thereafter uses that path's mode unless another feature explicitly overrides it.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Bishop's Mandate
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: Your Sacrament and one legal Divine Invocation target set
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.frequency: Automatic at Cleric 9; once per Sacrament start
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Bishop's Mandate. Tags: sacrament, invocation, capstone. When you legally start Sacrament, immediately resolve one free Divine Invocation using your selected Invocation Path. This free Invocation requires no Action, RP or Conviction, sets no Divine Invocation recharge and cannot itself trigger Bishop's Mandate. The Sacrament's own Conviction expenditure may still vent Dissonance normally.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Judgment
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.frequency: Automatic only if Judgment was selected
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Invocation Path — Judgment. Tags: invocation, judgment, smite. When your Divine Smite deals damage to a creature, mark it Judged for 2 rounds. A Judged creature has -1 AC. Further applications refresh the duration but do not increase the AC penalty.

currentApplicableEngineMechanicalDescrip: PROVISIONAL PLAYTEST CONTRACT. Wisdom is the Cleric class ability. S = 1/2/3/4 at Cleric levels 1/5/11/17. M = max(1, Wisdom modifier) unless a feature explicitly substitutes another ability. Cleric technique attack = d20 + normal character proficiency bonus + Wisdom modifier. Cleric technique save DC = 8 + normal character proficiency bonus + Wisdom modifier.

Conviction is separate from Resonance Points. Base Conviction maximum is 3, automatically becoming 5 at Cleric 9; after a long rest you begin at your current maximum. A completed short rest restores 1 spent Conviction, to the maximum. A completed long rest restores all Conviction. Conviction Pool raises the maximum by 2. Conviction persists between encounters; simply declaring prayer, repeating a Rite, or performing harmless actions outside a real encounter never generates Conviction.

Only explicit features generate Conviction. Sacred Chant, Sermon of Purpose, Doctrine Shield, Dark Conviction and other printed cards are valid generators. A feature cannot generate more Conviction than its text permits, and Conviction can never exceed the current maximum. Summoned creatures, friendly creatures, trivial creatures, repeated corpse manipulation and staged out-of-combat actions cannot be used to farm Conviction.

Cleric techniques use only their printed RP and Conviction costs. All RP is paid from the Cleric's Core Systems V 2 Resonance Point pool. A Cleric technique is not automatically an ordinary spell-rank cast and does not receive Overcast, spell-slot, cost-discount or spell-proc benefits unless a feature explicitly says otherwise. Ordinary spells continue to use Core V 2 spellcasting rules.

Protected Dissonance interaction: once on each of your regular turns, when you spend at least 2 Conviction on a Rite or Invocation, reduce Dissonance by 1, minimum 0. The expenditure must actually occur; waived Conviction costs do not vent Dissonance. A single feature expenditure vents at most once even if it spends more than 2 Conviction. No Cleric card automatically adds Dissonance unless explicitly written.

One concentration effect may be maintained at a time. Starting another concentration effect immediately ends the previous one. Damage uses the current Core Systems concentration rule; for this pilot, if a division requires rounding, half damage is rounded down. Sustained Cleric effects use their printed maintenance cost and Bonus Action. A control effect that persists for multiple pulses or rounds gives the target a new save at each printed pulse or at the end of each affected turn as stated.

Round recharge counters are set after resolution and decrease once at the start of the Cleric's regular initiative turn, even if the Cleric cannot act. Extra Actions and extra turns do not create extra recharge ticks. Outside initiative, each uninterrupted 6 seconds counts as one recharge tick. Only a positive counter may be reset or shortened, and a named ability can receive at most one reset or shortening per round.

Healing cannot exceed maximum HP, does not remove Wounds, and does not restore a dead creature unless a card explicitly says it resurrects. No Cleric feature provides unlimited permanent HP or resource restoration outside encounters. Temporary HP does not stack with itself; use the higher value. Resurrection and corpse-based effects have explicit use limits and cannot generate repeatable corpses, XP, loot or Conviction.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Divine Smite

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Healing Rite
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Healing Rite. Tags: rite, healing. One living ally regains S d8 + M HP. It cannot restore a dead creature or remove Wounds. Consecrated Ground and appropriate Invocation Path bonuses may modify this healing.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Conviction Pool
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Conviction Pool. Tags: conviction, passive. Increase your Conviction maximum by 2. This changes only the maximum; it does not immediately restore spent Conviction when acquired during play. A long rest restores Conviction to the new maximum.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Consecrated Ground
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Consecrated Ground. Tags: rite, healing, passive. Whenever one of your healing Rites restores HP to a living creature standing in terrain created by your Consecrate feature, that creature regains S additional HP. Apply this once per creature per Rite pulse; it is flat healing and is not itself another healing trigger.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Judging Light
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Judging Light. Tags: smite, passive. When your Divine Smite damages a creature currently affected by a Cursed or Weakened condition, add S d4 radiant damage to that Smite. Roll these dice once as part of the Smite; they do not create a second hit or trigger.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Fervent Ritualist
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Fervent Ritualist. Tags: rite, ritual, passive. This never reduces a Ritual below 1 minute and does not alter Action, Bonus Action or Reaction Rites.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Mirrorbind
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: One eligible witnessed creature within 60 ft
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Apply the engine's exact capture procedure: WIS save or store a bounded profile for the witnessed ability. State category/rank before save. Success prevents capture but consumes attempt; no target can be mirrored outside eligibility restrictions.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Echo Release
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.cost: Recorded rank RP cost; consume 1 Echo
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Resolve the stored Strike/Burst/Mend/Ward/Hindrance profile, using current S and INT. Pay before release; empty slot even if resisted. First release ignores only Refrain addition. No original source extra actions/resources/procs.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Reflective Pulse
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: Attacker within 30 ft after its first hit this round damages you
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Deal psychic damage equal to min(M, damage actually taken). This cannot critically hit, trigger another reflection, generate resources or prevent the original damage. No effect if you take 0.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Mirrorcall
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Beast gains+M maximum/current HP when summoned and+5 ft Speed. Echo Release or Mirror Beast Summon already provides its base procedure; this is an optional enhancement, not a second required unlock.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Echo Slot Expansion I
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: If an ordinary slot is full, replace one record while preserving its name/profile in an inert backup. Once before next long rest, after a slot empties, restore that backup without an Action. Total usable records remain at your capacity; backup cannot be cast directly or backed up again. An inert backup counts toward the absolute six-record archive ceiling. A backup cannot be created if usable records plus inert backups would exceed six.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Mirror Beast Summon
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Summon one standard Mirror Beast; replaces any prior Beast/Reflective Companion. Choose appearance of a stored source. It attacks only on Bonus Action command or originates your paid release with Action+command, never both. No copied anatomy, regeneration or immortality.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Reflective Analysis
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Learn whether it is capture-eligible and one visible ability's bounded profile/rank before attempting. The next Mirrorbind save it makes against you has-1. Nonstacking; does not reveal private thoughts or permit boss copying.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Echo Slot Expansion II
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Ordinary Echo storage capacity becomes 5, replacing 3. Restricted extra slots still obey total 6. New slots are empty; the feature creates no Echo records or spell access.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Charm Creature
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: One eligible INT 6-or-lower creature within 30 ft
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: WIS save or become Reflective Companion under engine restrictions. It repeats save at turn end and when harmed by your side. Replaces Mirror Beast; on end original disposition returns. Requires no suicidal orders; cannot force beliefs or permanently enslave.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Dual Echo Cast
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.cost: RP for each of 2 Echoes; consume both
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Release two records captured from different creatures as ONE combined release. Each deals/heals half its profile's rolled amount, round once per component. At most one Hindrance rider; no duplicated resources or additional release this round.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Mimicry Focus
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: At genuine encounter start gain 1 Focus Point, cap 1; any previous point is replaced. Spend on Focus Channel or pay 1 Focus during a release to add 1d6 to one damage/healing target. No point generation from staged combat.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Advanced Mirrorcall
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: You may change Beast appearance to another stored source as a Bonus Action without resummoning or restoring HP. It gains either+10 ft swim or climb Speed until it ends. No new release, attack or capture.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Beast Instinct
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: A failed Mirrorbind against eligible INT 6-or-lower source
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Force that target to reroll its successful save; use the second result. Eligibility, line of effect and an empty slot still required. Does not create a second captured record or a new encounter attempt.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Mirror Shell
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: A hostile spell targeting only you within 60 ft
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: After a successful save against the spell or after its spell attack misses, choose its caster; it makes WIS save or takes S d8 force. Original damage/control follow normal results. No copying arbitrary spell text or redirecting an area spell.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Mirror Image
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Create two decoys. When an attack hits you, use Reaction to erase one and impose disadvantage on that attack's reroll. Decoys do not cast, attack, intercept area damage or create Echo records. At most one decoy erased per round.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Floating Memory Slot
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Capacity becomes 6 if below 6; temporary slot is erased at encounter end. If already 6, choose one existing slot instead and its release gains+5 ft range. Never exceed 6 or preserve a seventh via a backup.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Perfect Reflection
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: Creature within 60 ft whose observed ability targets you
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Reduce triggering damage to you by(S+1)d8+M, minimum 0. If any is prevented, source makes WIS save or takes that prevented amount as force, maximum 30. This is your release action for the round; no reflected conditions or legendary powers. Cannot recursively reflect.

currentApplicableEngineMechanicalDescrip: Intelligence is the class ability; use d8 Hit Die from the detailed book, recording the older runtime d6 as superseded for this draft. You begin with 3 empty Echo Slots. Expansion II raises ordinary capacity 5; Sacred/Floating memory features may add one restricted slot, but total concurrent stored Echoes never exceeds 6. Slots are storage, not spell slots. Releasing normally empties that record. Rest restores RP, not spent Echoes. Starting a new encounter does not duplicate the archive.

Mirrorbind is an Action, once per encounter, against a creature within 60 ft whose eligible ability you saw resolve since the start of your previous turn. Target must have INT 6 or lower, not be a boss or possess unique/legendary status unless an encounter script explicitly permits copying. It makes WIS save versus class DC; failure captures one witnessed ability into an empty slot. No copying from allies, your companions, another copy, a corpse, a recharge-limited legendary power or an at-will source that itself restores resources. You can voluntarily erase a slot without an action on your turn, permanently losing its record.

Record source creature/name, witnessed ability, category, damage type, allowed rank, capture encounter and whether first release has occurred. For this pilot, capture copies the observed role into ONE bounded profile: Strike=one target 60 ft class spell attack S d8 observed damage type; Burst=up to 3 enemies in 10 ft radius within 30 ft DEX save S d6, half on success; Mend=one living ally 30 ft S d6+M HP; Ward=one ally 30 ft S d6+M temporary HP for 1 minute; Hindrance=one enemy 30 ft WIS save or Speed-10 ft and no Reactions until end its next turn. Choose only a profile actually expressed by the observed source; physical attack cannot become healing. Rank is max(1, ceil(source challenge rating/2)); if source lacks a rating the Director assigns a rank before the encounter, not after seeing a desirable ability. Rank cannot exceed your Mirrorsage learnable rank; no copying character levels from a creature. Damage/targets/control are capped by these profiles, not source boss dice.

Echo Release costs the Core V 2 RP cost of the recorded rank, minimum 2, consumes its record and counts as a spell for Dissonance and Refrain. Spell attack/DC use your own stats. First release of a newly captured record ignores Refrain addition only; base strain remains. Any preserved subsequent release uses ordinary repeated-spell strain. All released Echoes, pet replays, fusions and reflections share ONE release action per round; a specifically combined package counts once but pays for every component and has its printed damage cap. Copies cannot create resources or recursive Echoes.

One Mirror Beast OR Reflective Companion, never both. Mirror Beast uses standard companion stats, initially copies appearance only, and costs a Bonus Action to command. You may command it to make its normal attack OR originate your round's Echo Release from its position, paying RP and consuming the record normally; not both. You still supply an Action for release unless a feature specifically changes that action cost. A shifted appearance grants no extra actions/stats. Destroying/dismissing it grants no capture, corpse, XP or recovery. Charm Bind is 1/long rest, 3 rounds, concentration, INT 6-or-lower target WIS save and repeat at each turn end/when harmed by your side; never a player character or boss without explicit encounter permission. A charmed companion uses its own ordinary attack with damage capped at standard companion S d6; unique spells/powers remain unavailable.

Focus Point is a separate resource: when Mimicry Focus is known, receive 1 at encounter start, maximum 1, lost at encounter end. It can modify one Echo without generating another release, recapture or resource refund. No stacking damage doublings; use the printed modest die/range boost. Healing/support copies always consume RP and cannot restore RP or duplicate limited-use features.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Capacity becomes 6 if below 6; temporary slot is erased at encounter end. If already 6, choose one existing slot instead and its release gains+5 ft range. Never exceed 6 or preserve a seventh via a backup.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Perfect Reflection
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: Creature within 60 ft whose observed ability targets you
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Reduce triggering damage to you by(S+1)d8+M, minimum 0. If any is prevented, source makes WIS save or takes that prevented amount as force, maximum 30. This is your release action for the round; no reflected conditions or legendary powers. Cannot recursively reflect.

currentApplicableEngineMechanicalDescrip: Intelligence is the class ability; use d8 Hit Die from the detailed book, recording the older runtime d6 as superseded for this draft. You begin with 3 empty Echo Slots. Expansion II raises ordinary capacity 5; Sacred/Floating memory features may add one restricted slot, but total concurrent stored Echoes never exceeds 6. Slots are storage, not spell slots. Releasing normally empties that record. Rest restores RP, not spent Echoes. Starting a new encounter does not duplicate the archive.

Mirrorbind is an Action, once per encounter, against a creature within 60 ft whose eligible ability you saw resolve since the start of your previous turn. Target must have INT 6 or lower, not be a boss or possess unique/legendary status unless an encounter script explicitly permits copying. It makes WIS save versus class DC; failure captures one witnessed ability into an empty slot. No copying from allies, your companions, another copy, a corpse, a recharge-limited legendary power or an at-will source that itself restores resources. You can voluntarily erase a slot without an action on your turn, permanently losing its record.

Record source creature/name, witnessed ability, category, damage type, allowed rank, capture encounter and whether first release has occurred. For this pilot, capture copies the observed role into ONE bounded profile: Strike=one target 60 ft class spell attack S d8 observed damage type; Burst=up to 3 enemies in 10 ft radius within 30 ft DEX save S d6, half on success; Mend=one living ally 30 ft S d6+M HP; Ward=one ally 30 ft S d6+M temporary HP for 1 minute; Hindrance=one enemy 30 ft WIS save or Speed-10 ft and no Reactions until end its next turn. Choose only a profile actually expressed by the observed source; physical attack cannot become healing. Rank is max(1, ceil(source challenge rating/2)); if source lacks a rating the Director assigns a rank before the encounter, not after seeing a desirable ability. Rank cannot exceed your Mirrorsage learnable rank; no copying character levels from a creature. Damage/targets/control are capped by these profiles, not source boss dice.

Echo Release costs the Core V 2 RP cost of the recorded rank, minimum 2, consumes its record and counts as a spell for Dissonance and Refrain. Spell attack/DC use your own stats. First release of a newly captured record ignores Refrain addition only; base strain remains. Any preserved subsequent release uses ordinary repeated-spell strain. All released Echoes, pet replays, fusions and reflections share ONE release action per round; a specifically combined package counts once but pays for every component and has its printed damage cap. Copies cannot create resources or recursive Echoes.

One Mirror Beast OR Reflective Companion, never both. Mirror Beast uses standard companion stats, initially copies appearance only, and costs a Bonus Action to command. You may command it to make its normal attack OR originate your round's Echo Release from its position, paying RP and consuming the record normally; not both. You still supply an Action for release unless a feature specifically changes that action cost. A shifted appearance grants no extra actions/stats. Destroying/dismissing it grants no capture, corpse, XP or recovery. Charm Bind is 1/long rest, 3 rounds, concentration, INT 6-or-lower target WIS save and repeat at each turn end/when harmed by your side; never a player character or boss without explicit encounter permission. A charmed companion uses its own ordinary attack with damage capped at standard companion S d6; unique spells/powers remain unavailable.

Focus Point is a separate resource: when Mimicry Focus is known, receive 1 at encounter start, maximum 1, lost at encounter end. It can modify one Echo without generating another release, recapture or resource refund. No stacking damage doublings; use the printed modest die/range boost. Healing/support copies always consume RP and cannot restore RP or duplicate limited-use features.

Choose only a profile actually expressed by the observed source; physical attack cannot become healing. Rank is max(1, ceil(source challenge rating/2)); if source lacks a rating the Director assigns a rank before the encounter, not after seeing a desirable ability. Rank cannot exceed your Mirrorsage learnable rank; no copying character levels from a creature. Damage/targets/control are capped by these profiles, not source boss dice.

Echo Release costs the Core V 2 RP cost of the recorded rank, minimum 2, consumes its record and counts as a spell for Dissonance and Refrain. Spell attack/DC use your own stats. First release of a newly captured record ignores Refrain addition only; base strain remains. Any preserved subsequent release uses ordinary repeated-spell strain. All released Echoes, pet replays, fusions and reflections share ONE release action per round; a specifically combined package counts once but pays for every component and has its printed damage cap. Copies cannot create resources or recursive Echoes.

One Mirror Beast OR Reflective Companion, never both. Mirror Beast uses standard companion stats, initially copies appearance only, and costs a Bonus Action to command. You may command it to make its normal attack OR originate your round's Echo Release from its position, paying RP and consuming the record normally; not both. You still supply an Action for release unless a feature specifically changes that action cost. A shifted appearance grants no extra actions/stats. Destroying/dismissing it grants no capture, corpse, XP or recovery. Charm Bind is 1/long rest, 3 rounds, concentration, INT 6-or-lower target WIS save and repeat at each turn end/when harmed by your side; never a player character or boss without explicit encounter permission. A charmed companion uses its own ordinary attack with damage capped at standard companion S d6; unique spells/powers remain unavailable.

Focus Point is a separate resource: when Mimicry Focus is known, receive 1 at encounter start, maximum 1, lost at encounter end. It can modify one Echo without generating another release, recapture or resource refund. No stacking damage doublings; use the printed modest die/range boost. Healing/support copies always consume RP and cannot restore RP or duplicate limited-use features.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: One eligible witnessed creature within 60 ft
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Apply the engine's exact capture procedure: WIS save or store a bounded profile for the witnessed ability. State category/rank before save. Success prevents capture but consumes attempt; no target can be mirrored outside eligibility restrictions.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Echo Release
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.cost: Recorded rank RP cost; consume 1 Echo
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Resolve the stored Strike/Burst/Mend/Ward/Hindrance profile, using current S and INT. Pay before release; empty slot even if resisted. First release ignores only Refrain addition. No original source extra actions/resources/procs.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Reflective Pulse
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: Attacker within 30 ft after its first hit this round damages you
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Deal psychic damage equal to min(M, damage actually taken). This cannot critically hit, trigger another reflection, generate resources or prevent the original damage. No effect if you take 0.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Mirrorcall
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Beast gains+M maximum/current HP when summoned and+5 ft Speed. Echo Release or Mirror Beast Summon already provides its base procedure; this is an optional enhancement, not a second required unlock.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Echo Slot Expansion I
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: If an ordinary slot is full, replace one record while preserving its name/profile in an inert backup. Once before next long rest, after a slot empties, restore that backup without an Action. Total usable records remain at your capacity; backup cannot be cast directly or backed up again. An inert backup counts toward the absolute six-record archive ceiling. A backup cannot be created if usable records plus inert backups would exceed six.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Mirror Beast Summon
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Summon one standard Mirror Beast; replaces any prior Beast/Reflective Companion. Choose appearance of a stored source. It attacks only on Bonus Action command or originates your paid release with Action+command, never both. No copied anatomy, regeneration or immortality.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Reflective Analysis
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Learn whether it is capture-eligible and one visible ability's bounded profile/rank before attempting. The next Mirrorbind save it makes against you has-1. Nonstacking; does not reveal private thoughts or permit boss copying.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Echo Slot Expansion II
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Ordinary Echo storage capacity becomes 5, replacing 3. Restricted extra slots still obey total 6. New slots are empty; the feature creates no Echo records or spell access.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Charm Creature
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: One eligible INT 6-or-lower creature within 30 ft
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: WIS save or become Reflective Companion under engine restrictions. It repeats save at turn end and when harmed by your side. Replaces Mirror Beast; on end original disposition returns. Requires no suicidal orders; cannot force beliefs or permanently enslave.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Dual Echo Cast
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.cost: RP for each of 2 Echoes; consume both
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Release two records captured from different creatures as ONE combined release. Each deals/heals half its profile's rolled amount, round once per component. At most one Hindrance rider; no duplicated resources or additional release this round.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Mimicry Focus
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: At genuine encounter start gain 1 Focus Point, cap 1; any previous point is replaced. Spend on Focus Channel or pay 1 Focus during a release to add 1d6 to one damage/healing target. No point generation from staged combat.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Advanced Mirrorcall
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: You may change Beast appearance to another stored source as a Bonus Action without resummoning or restoring HP. It gains either+10 ft swim or climb Speed until it ends. No new release, attack or capture.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Beast Instinct
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: A failed Mirrorbind against eligible INT 6-or-lower source
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Force that target to reroll its successful save; use the second result. Eligibility, line of effect and an empty slot still required. Does not create a second captured record or a new encounter attempt.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Mirror Shell

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Mirror Image
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Create two decoys. When an attack hits you, use Reaction to erase one and impose disadvantage on that attack's reroll. Decoys do not cast, attack, intercept area damage or create Echo records. At most one decoy erased per round.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Apply the engine's exact capture procedure: WIS save or store a bounded profile for the witnessed ability. State category/rank before save. Success prevents capture but consumes attempt; no target can be mirrored outside eligibility restrictions.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Echo Release
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.cost: Recorded rank RP cost; consume 1 Echo
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Resolve the stored Strike/Burst/Mend/Ward/Hindrance profile, using current S and INT. Pay before release; empty slot even if resisted. First release ignores only Refrain addition. No original source extra actions/resources/procs.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Reflective Pulse
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: Attacker within 30 ft after its first hit this round damages you
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Deal psychic damage equal to min(M, damage actually taken). This cannot critically hit, trigger another reflection, generate resources or prevent the original damage. No effect if you take 0.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Mirrorcall
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Beast gains+M maximum/current HP when summoned and+5 ft Speed. Echo Release or Mirror Beast Summon already provides its base procedure; this is an optional enhancement, not a second required unlock.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Echo Slot Expansion I
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: If an ordinary slot is full, replace one record while preserving its name/profile in an inert backup. Once before next long rest, after a slot empties, restore that backup without an Action. Total usable records remain at your capacity; backup cannot be cast directly or backed up again. An inert backup counts toward the absolute six-record archive ceiling. A backup cannot be created if usable records plus inert backups would exceed six.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Mirror Beast Summon
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Summon one standard Mirror Beast; replaces any prior Beast/Reflective Companion. Choose appearance of a stored source. It attacks only on Bonus Action command or originates your paid release with Action+command, never both. No copied anatomy, regeneration or immortality.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Reflective Analysis
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Learn whether it is capture-eligible and one visible ability's bounded profile/rank before attempting. The next Mirrorbind save it makes against you has-1. Nonstacking; does not reveal private thoughts or permit boss copying.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Echo Slot Expansion II
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Ordinary Echo storage capacity becomes 5, replacing 3. Restricted extra slots still obey total 6. New slots are empty; the feature creates no Echo records or spell access.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Charm Creature
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: One eligible INT 6-or-lower creature within 30 ft
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: WIS save or become Reflective Companion under engine restrictions. It repeats save at turn end and when harmed by your side. Replaces Mirror Beast; on end original disposition returns. Requires no suicidal orders; cannot force beliefs or permanently enslave.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Dual Echo Cast
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.cost: RP for each of 2 Echoes; consume both
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Release two records captured from different creatures as ONE combined release. Each deals/heals half its profile's rolled amount, round once per component. At most one Hindrance rider; no duplicated resources or additional release this round.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Mimicry Focus
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: At genuine encounter start gain 1 Focus Point, cap 1; any previous point is replaced. Spend on Focus Channel or pay 1 Focus during a release to add 1d6 to one damage/healing target. No point generation from staged combat.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Advanced Mirrorcall
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: You may change Beast appearance to another stored source as a Bonus Action without resummoning or restoring HP. It gains either+10 ft swim or climb Speed until it ends. No new release, attack or capture.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Beast Instinct
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: A failed Mirrorbind against eligible INT 6-or-lower source
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Force that target to reroll its successful save; use the second result. Eligibility, line of effect and an empty slot still required. Does not create a second captured record or a new encounter attempt.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Mirror Shell
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: A hostile spell targeting only you within 60 ft
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: After a successful save against the spell or after its spell attack misses, choose its caster; it makes WIS save or takes S d8 force. Original damage/control follow normal results. No copying arbitrary spell text or redirecting an area spell.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Divine Reflection
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: Willing allied caster within 30 ft just used an eligible healing/protection spell
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Capture a Mend or Ward profile of rank at most your learnable rank into empty slot. This explicit exception permits an allied source but excludes resurrection/resource/action generation. No extra captured use for the ally and no copying a copy.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Sacred Echo Slot
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Add one slot usable only for Mend or Ward, total storage cap 6. If already at 6, designate one existing slot sacred instead; once/short rest its release costs 1 less RP, minimum 1. No duplicate slot or free record.

actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.name: Perfect Reflection
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.rangeAndTarget: Creature within 60 ft whose observed ability targets you
actuallyAcquiredFeatureMechanicalDescrip.effect: Reduce triggering damage to you by(S+1)d8+M, minimum 0. If any is prevented, source makes WIS save or takes that prevented amount as force, maximum 30. This is your release action for the round; no reflected conditions or legendary powers. Cannot recursively reflect.

currentApplicableEngineMechanicalDescrip: Intelligence is the class ability; use d8 Hit Die from the detailed book, recording the older runtime d6 as superseded for this draft. You begin with 3 empty Echo Slots. Expansion II raises ordinary capacity 5; Sacred/Floating memory features may add one restricted slot, but total concurrent stored Echoes never exceeds 6. Slots are storage, not spell slots. Releasing normally empties that record. Rest restores RP, not spent Echoes. Starting a new encounter does not duplicate the archive.

Mirrorbind is an Action, once per encounter, against a creature within 60 ft whose eligible ability you saw resolve since the start of your previous turn. Target must have INT 6 or lower, not be a boss or possess unique/legendary status unless an encounter script explicitly permits copying. It makes WIS save versus class DC; failure captures one witnessed ability into an empty slot. No copying from allies, your companions, another copy, a corpse, a recharge-limited legendary power or an at-will source that itself restores resources. You can voluntarily erase a slot without an action on your turn, permanently losing its record.

Record source creature/name, witnessed ability, category, damage type, allowed rank, capture encounter and whether first release has occurred. For this pilot, capture copies the observed role into ONE bounded profile: Strike=one target 60 ft class spell attack S d8 observed damage type; Burst=up to 3 enemies in 10 ft radius within 30 ft DEX save S d6, half on success; Mend=one living ally 30 ft S d6+M HP; Ward=one ally 30 ft S d6+M temporary HP for 1 minute; Hindrance=one enemy 30 ft WIS save or Speed-10 ft and no Reactions until end its next turn. Choose only a profile actually expressed by the observed source; physical attack cannot become healing. Rank is max(1, ceil(source challenge rating/2)); if source lacks a rating the Director assigns a rank before the encounter, not after seeing a desirable ability. Rank cannot exceed your Mirrorsage learnable rank; no copying character levels from a creature. Damage/targets/control are capped by these profiles, not source boss dice.

Echo Release costs the Core V 2 RP cost of the recorded rank, minimum 2, consumes its record and counts as a spell for Dissonance and Refrain. Spell attack/DC use your own stats. First release of a newly captured record ignores Refrain addition only; base strain remains. Any preserved subsequent release uses ordinary repeated-spell strain. All released Echoes, pet replays, fusions and reflections share ONE release action per round; a specifically combined package counts once but pays for every component and has its printed damage cap. Copies cannot create resources or recursive Echoes.

One Mirror Beast OR Reflective Companion, never both. Mirror Beast uses standard companion stats, initially copies appearance only, and costs a Bonus Action to command. You may command it to make its normal attack OR originate your round's Echo Release from its position, paying RP and consuming the record normally; not both. You still supply an Action for release unless a feature specifically changes that action cost. A shifted appearance grants no extra actions/stats. Destroying/dismissing it grants no capture, corpse, XP or recovery. Charm Bind is 1/long rest, 3 rounds, concentration, INT 6-or-lower target WIS save and repeat at each turn end/when harmed by your side; never a player character or boss without explicit encounter permission. A charmed companion uses its own ordinary attack with damage capped at standard companion S d6; unique spells/powers remain unavailable.

Focus Point is a separate resource: when Mimicry Focus is known, receive 1 at encounter start, maximum 1, lost at encounter end. It can modify one Echo without generating another release, recapture or resource refund. No stacking damage doublings; use the printed modest die/range boost. Healing/support copies always consume RP and cannot restore RP or duplicate limited-use features.
